Later the real OHLCV bar UPSERTs over the stub so canonical reads clean by 04:30Z. This is feedback_ohlcv_startup_purge_defeated_by_backfill_seeder: a re-seeding WRITER defeats the repair; fix the WRITER not the residue; trace ALL writers into daily_ohlcv (this was the un-migrated straggler).

entries.product_decision: Option (a) chosen: re-enable prediction synthesis on a DAILY cadence by routing digest-predict to a daily prediction sub-flow + a new daily cowork slot, WITHOUT disturbing the Sunday weekly calibration report. Daily update = a daily synthesis run that CREATES new high-conviction claims when fresh evidence appears AND lets existing open claims keep accruing toward their multi-day/weekly horizon (e.g. W26). It is NOT a forced 5-claims-every-day spam. GUARDRAILS (designed by architect first): (1) per-DAY cap (small, e.g. 2-3) replacing the monday max_prediction_claims_per_week:5, with a weekly ceiling so cadence cannot inflate claim volume; (2) same-day idempotency marker via task_claim (TTL ~20h) keyed on day+slot so a re-fire never double-creates; (3) NO-OP cleanly when no ticker passes the bullish/bearish>0.6 high-conviction filter (do NOT lower the bar to manufacture daily claims — standing no-fake-data directive); (4) Sunday weekly.md calibration report stays unchanged + un-regressed.

backlog.title: Harden notebook-write AC-5 from advisory prose to BLOCKING (exit 1 -> force recompose) + commit headless-path hook backstop into repo
backlog.desc: ROOT CAUSE (router pass #11, raw-verified 2026-06-15): notebook-write SKILL layer-1 gate is advisory PROSE not a hard bash gate. AC-5 (SKILL line 76) is explicitly 'a verification gate, NOT a remediation loop' — it only echoes a warning, never exit 1/blocks. This CONTRADICTS the governance founding principle (project_context_bloat_governance line 13: 'Hard bash gate, not prose — haiku skips prose'). Evidence: ops.md re-breached to 237L (working-tree; HEAD 151L) AFTER its own agent-father retrofit 1c8a5ea7; the 237L write minted NO context-bloat signal (layer-2 PostToolUse hook is record-only exit 0 AND lives in gitignored .claude/settings.local.json so headless/cron/cloud spawns don't carry it). Layer-3 janitor is the ONLY hard remediation and it's reactive — board is littered with recurring CLEAN-NB-TRIM-* / FU-NB-PRUNE-* tasks (CLEAN-NB-TRIM-BATCH = 5 notebooks 297/223/223/218/228L; CLEAN-CONTEXT-BLOAT-NOTEBOOKS-20260614; CLEAN-NB-TRIM-PDFX-2; FU-NB-PRUNE-DEV-VPS), proving the reactive churn. SCOPE (the cheap correct slice — NOT a full architecture sprint): (1) Convert AC-5 to BLOCKING for the in-session/compliant-tooling path: after the settled write, if wc -l > cap then exit 1 and force the agent to recompose+re-write (a hard gate can only FAIL the write, NOT auto-pick which sections to drop — semantic prune needs agent judgment, that is the accepted tradeoff). (2) Close the headless/cron gap: commit the PostToolUse backstop hook wiring into a REPO-TRACKED settings file (.claude/settings.json, NOT .local) so cron/headless/cloud spawns carry it — OR add a documented dumb-tail-truncate fallback in the hook for non-compliant writes as a last-resort self-heal (architect decides truncate-vs-fail-vs-signal-only). DESIGN TRADEOFF to resolve in brief: dumb tail-cut loses the newest section (usually the current cycle's content) — may be unacceptable; a fail-the-write gate can't run in a fire-and-forget headless write that has no agent loop to recompose. Architect weighs blocking-in-session + signal-only-headless vs truncate-headless.

backlog.title: Health-recheck BCTC monitor misreads idle-queue-0-running as CRASH (push-age>360min false P0)
backlog.desc: The analysis-agent health-recheck cron flags vn-bctc-fetch as CRASHED/UNHEALTHY (SLA breach) whenever last-push-age > 360min, but cannot distinguish a legitimately IDLE pipeline (service active+running, queue EMPTY because 9-11 watchlist tickers simply have not filed Q1-2026 yet) from an actual DOWN service. dev-team SSH RAW-verified 2026-06-19T16:20Z (report 3256): vn-bctc-fetch active(running) 8+ days, NO crash, queue legitimately empty. This monitor fires a false BCTC P0 ~every 2h, spamming health-recheck reports (~14 of reports 3244-3262). DISTINCT FROM FIX-BCTC-FRESHNESS-GATE (done_verified) which gates SERVICE health on last_success_age — that is the inverse (make gate MORE sensitive); THIS task makes the CRASH classifier require service-state + queue-depth probe before declaring crash. Same class as memory feedback_bctc_lastpush_age_misread_as_crash + feedback_false_infra_failure_corroboration_gate.
backlog.root_cause: Crash detector keys on last-push-age>360min alone (event-driven push age) without checking service-state (active/running) AND queue-depth. push-age is high whenever the queue is empty/idle (no filings due), which is normal off-filing-season, not a crash.
backlog.fix_spec: Locate the BCTC crash/SLA classifier feeding the analysis-agent health-recheck report (candidates: apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/financial-reports/bctcOverdueCheckJob.ts, scheduler/vpsProxyWatchdogJob.ts, interface/mcp/routes/fetchStatusHandler.ts). Gate the CRASH/UNHEALTHY verdict on: service-state != active/running OR (queue-depth > 0 AND last-success-age > SLA). When queue-depth == 0 AND service running == idle-waiting -> emit INFO (idle, no filings due), NEVER P0 crash. Generic: derive SLA window only over tickers with an EXPECTED-but-missing filing, not calendar age. Add a unit test: idle-queue-0-running + push-age>360min -> verdict=IDLE/INFO (not CRASH); down-service OR (queue>0 AND age>SLA) -> CRASH.
backlog.verification_gate: Unit: idle-queue-0-running + push-age>360min => INFO not CRASH; service-down => CRASH; queue>0 & age>SLA => CRASH. Live: next health-recheck cron tick over a running-idle vn-bctc-fetch emits NO false BCTC P0.
backlog.generic_mandate: Fix the classifier generically (service-state + queue-depth gate), not a vn-bctc-fetch special-case; applies to any event-driven pipeline whose push-age is idle-dependent.

backlog.title: fb-gate Check-C: negation-blind to Vietnamese 'chưa' false-blocks orderly-pullback posts + \d->[0-9] BSD-grep portability
backlog.lesson: L4 (2026-06-25 -0,80% orderly post FALSE-BLOCKED twice: 'chưa hoảng loạn'/'chưa phải bán tháo' counted AFFIRMATIVE — 'chưa' absent from Check-C negation-strip set)
backlog.desc: Check-C builds SELLOFF_AFFIRM_LINES by removing lines that match the negation set {không phải|không có|không bán|chứ không|mà không} (line ~342). 'chưa' (not yet/not) is NOT in that set, so an explicitly-negated panic statement ('lực bán chưa hoảng loạn', 'chưa phải bán tháo') survives the strip, is counted as an AFFIRMATIVE selloff claim, and on a mild day (|VN-Index|<2%, ~0 floor) FALSE-BLOCKS a correct non-panic post. FIX (1): add 'chưa' and common variants ('chưa phải','chưa từng') to the negation-stripping lexicon. FIX (2): replace `\d` with `[0-9]` in the floor-stock regex `chỉ \d mã sàn` (line ~361) — BSD grep -E on macOS treats `\d` literally; `[0-9]` is GNU/BSD portable.
backlog.generic_mandate: Broaden the negation lexicon generically (any 'chưa'-prefixed negation of panic language), not a one-off literal; the [0-9] portability fix applies to EVERY `\d` in the gate's grep -E patterns — audit the whole script for stray `\d` while here.
backlog.verification_gate: Add a fixture post containing 'lực bán chưa hoảng loạn' / 'chưa phải bán tháo' on a MILD day (live VN-Index between -2% and 0, snapshot stubbed) -> gate MUST PASS (Check-C 0 violations). Add a contrasting fixture with an AFFIRMATIVE 'thị trường bán tháo, hoảng loạn' on a mild day -> Check-C MUST still BLOCK. Confirm `chỉ [0-9] mã sàn` matches under the macOS BSD grep -E used by the gate.

RAW status-breakdown of those 248: 242 (~97.6%) carry a TERMINAL status (163 DONE / 40 DONE-LIVE-VERIFIED / 14 done / 7 done_verified + CANCELLED/CLOSED-NO-CHANGE/CLOSED-NOT-REPRO/SUPERSEDED/DEFERRED); only ~6 are non-terminal (2 TODO, 3 BACKLOG, 1 blocked-probe5). Stop counting DONE/done_verified/CANCELLED/CLOSED/SUPERSEDED tasks toward an active-WIP cap.

backlog.title: cowork last_fired is bumped on spawn DISPATCH-success, not delivery proof -> a spawn that dies before writing its notebook still satisfies the cadence gate -> genuine slot misses are MASKED (matcher never re-offers)
backlog.description: RAW-verified 2026-06-26 from cowork-dispatcher signals (00:19Z cowork_spawn_completion + 00:22Z blind-correction) and confirmed in docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/last-fired.md Step 5b: last_fired updates for WON_SLOTS where 'won' = the run_in_background spawn handle returned (AC-P1-7-1 'last_fired written after successful spawn'), NOT delivery confirmation (notebook mtime advance / marker file). A backgrounded spawn that dispatches then dies before delivering still bumps last_fired; cowork-match-slots.js then reads the bumped stamp, sees the 4h cadence satisfied, and never re-offers the slot -> the miss is invisible. OBSERVED: news-scout-offhours 00:00 master-cron fire bumped last_fired 00:02:36Z but produced NO c108 notebook cycle (latest real c108 @ 06-25T16:04Z; both 20:00 and 00:00 slots un-run), while sibling bctc-analyst-slot-4 + market-watcher-offhours DID deliver real cycles -> gateway was up -> the news-scout spawn died before delivery. Same masking class as the prior bctc-analyst-slot-3 master-cron gap. The dispatcher only caught it via an ad-hoc marker-safe recovery spawn (which then turned out blind) — there is no SYSTEMIC delivery-confirmation gate.
backlog.fix_spec: ARCHITECT confirm zone split + design first (do NOT pre-commit to an approach). The hard constraint: spawns are run_in_background (fire-and-forget) so the dispatcher CANNOT synchronously await delivery within one tick. Candidate designs to evaluate: (A) DEFERRED-CONFIRM ledger — on spawn, record a pending_delivery{slot_id, dispatched_at, expected_artifact} marker and DO NOT bump last_fired; on a SUBSEQUENT tick, bump last_fired only if the slot's delivery artifact (notebook mtime > dispatched_at, or a per-slot delivery marker) advanced, else re-offer the slot (bounded retry budget to avoid thrash). (B) POST-SPAWN short delivery poll before the Step 5b write (bounded, < tick budget). (C) artifact-driven cadence — derive 'last delivered' from the slot's real delivery artifact mtime rather than a dispatch-stamped field, making last_fired advisory. Architect picks; BA decomposes into dev-ready fix_spec+files. cowork-schedule.json is _maintained_by agent-father via architect brief ONLY (never direct edit) — flow-doc + matcher changes route to dev-mcp-server / agent-father per the split.
backlog.generic_mandate: Cadence suppression MUST be gated on DELIVERY PROOF, not dispatch success, for ALL fire-and-forget cowork slots (not just news-scout) — a slot whose spawn dispatched but never delivered must remain due. Applies to every */4h + guaranteed slot in cowork-schedule.json. No hardcoded slot lists — derive from the schedule.
backlog.verification_gate: Simulate a slot whose spawn DISPATCHES successfully but produces NO delivery artifact (no notebook mtime advance / no marker) within the delivery window -> last_fired is NOT advanced (or the slot is re-offered next tick) AND the matcher re-offers it on the next cron period; a slot that DOES deliver advances last_fired exactly once and is correctly suppressed. Both behaviors covered by cowork-match-slots.test.js (or its successor). Confirm no re-fire thrash on a slow-but-eventually-delivering spawn (bounded retry).
backlog.distinct_from: FIX-COWORK-SCHEDULE-STALE-BASE-CLOBBER (done_verified 30b9a7f8) was a stale-base read-modify-write clobbering OTHER slots' stamps, fixed by a monotonic forward-only guard. THIS defect is a SINGLE slot's last_fired advanced on dispatch-success when its OWN delivery never occurred — the monotonic guard does NOT catch it (the bumped value is genuinely forward-moving, just unbacked by delivery).

backlog.title: task_claim owner_session is server-INSTANCE-scoped (pid+startupTs), not client-scoped -> concurrent clients on one mcp-server collapse to one owner identity -> re-entrant self-reclaim returns claimed:true -> mutual exclusion DEFEATED (cowork double-fire)
backlog.root_cause: apps/mcp-server/src/interface/mcp/tools/system/coordinationTools.ts:52-56 SERVER_SESSION_ID is a single module-level const `pid-${process.pid}-ts-${startMs}` computed ONCE per process and stamped as owner_session on EVERY claim (L117) regardless of caller. Doc comment L18 (coordinationStore.ts) + L11/L20-21 (coordinationTools.ts) state owner_session SHOULD be the per-client Claude Code session id injected by the gateway, but the live value proves the unshipped Phase-2 fallback (process pid+boot) is active. Two concurrent clients sharing one mcp-server therefore get the IDENTICAL owner_session -> a second client's claim on a held lock is treated as a re-entrant SELF-reclaim -> claimed:true -> leader-lock + per-slot mutex CANNOT serialize concurrent dispatchers.
backlog.raw_verification: router dev-team tick 2026-06-26T05:22Z + PO RAW-confirm via task_list_held: SIX concurrent locks across FOUR distinct owner_agents (dev-team, unified-agent, cowork-dispatcher, cowork-team) ALL carry the IDENTICAL owner_session pid-1-ts-1782423559593 (server uptime ~7.8h, matches auditor Tier-1 7h33m). Older locks from prior server lifetimes carry DIFFERENT ts (1782401745780, 1782362316958, ...) confirming owner_session rotates ONLY on mcp-server restart, NOT per client. Code root confirmed in coordinationTools.ts:52-56,117.
backlog.observed_impact: cowork DOUBLE-FIRE this session: news-scout-sentiment spawned twice (a89c1b41@05:02 + a404d93d@05:03); chef slots fired twice (a29c5bcd@05:16 + parallel@05:21). BOUNDED not corrupting: published:<slot>:<date|hour> marker gate prevented double MARKET posts; gatherers have E3/exec-proof idempotency. Damage = wasted spawns/fetches, not bad data.
backlog.fix_options: PLAN-ONLY for architect — DO NOT implement: (a) PREFERRED ship the already-documented Phase-2 — derive owner_session from the per-request MCP transport session (RequestHandlerExtra.sessionId) instead of the process-global SERVER_SESSION_ID const, so each client/connection gets a distinct token; (b) add an explicit owner-token arg to task_claim so re-entrancy is opt-in and cross-client claims correctly return claimed:false with current_holder. RAW-verify on the live lock table before/after (re-run task_list_held: two concurrent claimers must show DISTINCT owner_session).

backlog.title: SBV-FX (+news) SLA: post-publish-window relaxation + poll-cadence tolerance band
backlog.root_cause: getSlaThreshold() (freshnessSlaChecker.ts L646-652) applies the tight defaultThresholdMinutes (30) for the WHOLE VN business day whenever isVnSbvBusinessDay(now)==true. But SBV publishes FX once/day; its publish window ends 10:00 UTC (lastExpectedSbvWindowEnd L530). After 10:00Z no new sbv_fx arrives until the next business-day window, yet the 30-min tight SLA stays active all day -> age sawtooths against the ~30-min fetcher poll cadence and breaches HIGH at the top of every cycle (Fri 10:33Z age 37/30). The DONE FIX-SLA-EXEMPT-NEWS-SBVFX relaxes ONLY on non-business days (weekend/holiday); the post-publish-window-on-a-business-day window AND the SLA==poll-cadence sawtooth are uncovered. Same structural pattern hits news (tight 30-min SLA for the whole 00:00-14:59Z window vs ~30-min poll -> news sawtoothed OK->32/30 in the same tick). Same over-fire CLASS as B-11 (market-hours-blind) and C-06 (off-market).
backlog.fix_spec: 1) Post-window relaxation on business days: in the SBV branch, once now is PAST lastExpectedSbvWindowEnd for today, switch to (minutesSinceLastSbvWindowEnd + grace) instead of the tight 30-min -> the tight SLA applies DURING the expected publish window only, not all day. Mirror for news post-14:59Z. 2) Tolerance band so SLA never equals poll cadence: breach HIGH only when age > MAX(threshold*1.5, threshold + pollCadence); a 30-min SLA on a 30-min poller must not fire on a single-cycle slip. Apply uniformly to news + sbv_fx.
backlog.generic_mandate: Derive publish-window-end + poll-cadence from config per source; do NOT hardcode per-source magic. The post-window relaxation + tolerance band must cover BOTH news and sbv_fx (and be safe for any once-per-window source).
backlog.verification_gate: On any post-10:00Z business-day time get_sla_status returns sbv_fx ok (not HIGH); news ok post-14:59Z. A genuine >1.5x stall DURING the live publish window still breaches. Add unit tests in freshnessSlaChecker.spec for business-day-post-window + single-cycle sawtooth tolerance.
backlog.severity_note: Auditor B-12-POST-MARKET emitted this as WARN (not HIGH); router live get_sla_status renders it HIGH. The HIGH severity on a 6-min once-per-day-FX poll slip with market CLOSED is the over-statement this task removes.
